enterprises.title: Enterprises & warehouses
enterprises.description: Every company on this server, and the warehouses each one runs.
enterprises.emptyDescription: Companies returned by the server will appear here.
enterprises.warehousesDescription: Select an enterprise above to see the warehouses it operates. The warehouse is the unit everything underneath it is scoped to — the till, the stock and the staff.
enterprises.selectHint: Select an enterprise above to see its warehouses.
enterprises.scopeNotice: This session is signed in against a different company code, and the warehouse endpoint has no per-enterprise filter. Listing warehouses here could show another company's records, so the list is withheld.
enterprises.myDescription: Your company's details, and the warehouses it operates.
enterprises.identityDescription: These come from your company's own record on the server. Contact the system administrator to change the company name or plan.
enterprises.noOperationalAccess: This company's access is currently suspended, so new records cannot be saved. Contact the system administrator.
enterprises.myWarehousesDescription: A warehouse sets the scope of the till, the stock and the staff working in it. Add one for each site your company runs.
enterprises.myWarehousesEmpty: Add a warehouse, then record purchases, stock and till movements against it.

contact.heading: Contact details
contact.description: Printed on the letterhead of your receipts and payslips.
contact.editDescription: Your company's names and the contact details shown at the top of every document you print. Leave an optional field empty to leave it off.
contact.displayNameHint: Shown in the app and on your documents.
contact.legalNameHint: The registered name, if different. Optional.
